description: Claude Code-driven X (Twitter) engagement assistant: searches and scores posts, builds like/follow candidate lists per target segment, and delivers them to Chatwork for manual action. Fork and set your own tokens.
rules: All tokens live in the forked repository's environment variables or .env; nothing is committed.
Likes and follows are manual by design because the X API self-serve tiers removed likePost and followUser.
Bundled templates target a tax-accounting firm with client, peer and recruit segments; adapt them to your own segments.
